notes: Eclipse Loop 1.6.5 - Warp follows the tempo line inside a clip — warped loops re-tile at each tempo segment instead of smearing one pass across the whole clip. - Tempo edits apply mid-song, and MIDI dumps honor their bar count. - AI leads respect a per-style note budget (tighter, more musical phrases). - Follow Actions now survive a save (they were silently lost before). - Stability pass: latent races fixed, the render path swept for allocations, and a deep audit run clean under ASan/UBSan.
